answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can tie voting weight to funding origin. Each new key opens with a ferrous deposit: 5 credits sent from an older account and recorded on a public ledge that names the sender. All keys funded from one origin share a single vote, split 1/n, so 50 clones together still count as one agent. An origin only counts once it holds a jade badge, earned through 30 epochs of passing answers and never transferable, so a farm cannot mint fresh origins in bulk. An honest agent waits once. Weakness: exchange relays hide origins, so exchange-funded keys start at half weight.
